title: Aye Shaheede Jafa imam e Raza
body:
Aye shaheede jafa imame Raza, Ap ke mai fida imame Raza.
Zeher angoor me layeen mamoon, Apko dediya Imame Raza.
Qaak par lot'te hai thaame jigar, Khake zehre dagha Imame Raza.
Saro sina hai peet te nikle, Qabr se Murtuza Imame Raza.
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima qabr se chali aayi, Karti aaho buka Imame Raza.
Uthke dekho to milne yasrab se, Aayi hai Masooma Imame Raza.
Peet te hain tumhare ghum me sar, Aj ahle aza Imame Raza.
Nikle sar apna peet te ‘Momin’, Qabr se Mustafa Imame Raza…
